_comment: The POSITIVE half of the '{cost}, {T}' self-funding pair -- see
tap_ability_self_funding_unpayable.json for the bug, the cause, and the four affected cards.
Identical board plus a fifth Forest, so the pool is 6 and Mariposa's '{5}, {T}: Draw a card' is
genuinely payable once its own {C} is debited: tap Mariposa for the ability, pay {5} off the
five Forests. It must still verdict `accept`.
This half is the one that would catch an over-tight fix, and it is the reason the debit lives in
the per-selection pool rather than at the emission site. An emission-time affordability gate
prices the ability against the PRE-CAST board, which would also hide an activation funded by a
mana rock the same plan casts -- the identical unsoundness that got the human-play trial-pay
removed from the Wirewood Lodge untap (docs/design/enumerated-but-unplayable-activations.md).
A fixture that only pinned the negative direction would have passed that broken fix.
It passes on BOTH arms of MTG_TAP_ABILITY_DEBIT by design: a non-discriminating fixture is the
point of a boundary pair. Its twin carries the discrimination.
